name: Otay Ranch Town Center
description: Otay Ranch Town Center is a premier open-air lifestyle shopping destination in Chula Vista, California, offering a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. The center features modern architecture and landscaped walkways that create an inviting atmosphere for shopping and leisure. Anchored by major retailers and complemented by specialty shops, it serves as a central hub for the growing Otay Ranch community.
summary: A modern open-air lifestyle center serving the Otay Ranch community with a compelling mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options.
